== Summary ==
Japanese [[E-web Blaster (Japanese)|E-web Blaster]] with a blank title strip. Crop of the embedded photograph on collecting encyclopedia p. 48, xref 2100. Original pixels retained at native size.<ref name="missing-title-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 48. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Crop rectangle (left, top, right, bottom): <code>(7, 4, 602, 837)</code>. Image SHA-256: <code>f9b105f1376e161127305c0be1810af06240047f581b0780f6ef0e4b3f79b8c3</code>. The card credits Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
